{{Quote|The original manuscript of Uueg Tching's ''Sayings'' was kept for the last 3,000 years in the Rare Books Department of the Atrisian Imperial Historical Library on Kitel Phard.|Lecture by Doctor Corellia Antilles|<ref name="From the Files of Corellia Antilles">{{JournalCite|14|From the Files of Corellia Antilles}}</ref>}}
The '''Atrisian Imperial Historical Library''' housed the original scrolls of [[Uueg Tching]]'s ''[[Sayings]]'' until [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. The [[Rare Books Department]] was part of the library.
